verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only names 'Scheduling' as a module of Ashby's all-in-one platform and lists interview scheduling as a webhook event type. Neither documents candidate self-scheduling booking links, live calendar availability, team calendar integration, or timezone handling. A generic module label and an event hook are adjacent signals, not evidence of this capability, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a recruiter, candidates self-schedule from live calendar availability — booking links tied to my team's calendars end the timezone email chains
